entries.8a819752bdcebc31: It has formulated a 3-year medium-term management plan covering the fiscal years ending January 2027 through January 2029. In sourcing land for family condominiums, its policy is to research a wide area rather than limit itself to the Fukuoka metropolitan area, where land prices are rising, and to steadily pursue projects that can secure earnings. For asset-management condominiums, it is considering strengthening sales capabilities and diversifying sales methods; for leasing management, it aims to increase the number of managed units and maintain a vacancy rate in the 3% range; and for building maintenance, it aims to increase construction contract projects and reinforce its workforce.
